name: Trust Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Hope

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the word of hope power of the hope domain.

Trusted Words (Sp)

You gain a bonus to Diplomacy checks to alleviate despair (See New Skill Uses on page 43 of this book), convince others to restrain hostilities via Make a Request, or to improve attitude above hostile or unfriendly equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum +1). This does not provide a bonus toward improving any attitude above unfriendly, gathering information, making other requests, suggesting courses of action or bartering. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd-build trust, 5th–telepathic bond
